title: Front-End Engineer
about: Front-end engineer specializing in AI-powered features. I've built conversational AI experiences including a streaming chat UI, agentic data exploration tools, and automated eval pipelines. Strong background in React and TypeScript, with 7+ years across product companies in the US and India.
